script.3:
3. 다음을듣고, 여자가하는말의목적으로가장적절한것을고르시오.
W: Hello, Riverwalk High School students! I’m your math teacher, Ms. Woods.
As you know, the application period for the Math & Dream Scholarship is approaching. However, there have been some changes to how to apply this year. Today, I’d like to let you know about them. The first change is that you need to fill out and submit an online application. In addition, you have to submit your plan to study in a mathematics-related field along with your application. It should be no more than 400 words. Finally, all applicants for this scholarship need to provide two letters of recommendation instead of one. For more information, please come and see me. Thank you.
script.4:
4. 대화를듣고, 남자의의견으로가장적절한것을고르시오.
M: Amy, what are you doing? It’s midnight.
W: Dad, I’m practicing for the school play.
M: You’ve practiced a lot today. I’m worried you’re staying up too late.
W: But I keep forgetting what to say. I’m having difficulty memorizing the script.
M: I know the play is important, but you need enough sleep.
W: Dad, I don’t want to make a mistake in front of people.
M: I understand. But to memorize better, you need to sleep at least 7 hours.
Getting enough sleep helps strengthen your memory.
W: Really? How can sleep strengthen my memory?
M: Your brain gets refreshed through sleep. So if you get enough sleep, you can memorize better.
W: Now I understand how getting enough sleep can strengthen my memory. I’ll go to bed now.
M: Great. Good night.
script.5:
5. 대화를듣고, 두사람의관계를가장잘나타낸것을고르시오.
W: Hello, Mr. Watson. Long time no see. How have you been?
M: I’ve been great, Ms. Brown. Wow, it has changed a lot here.
W: Yeah. We’ve recently renovated. What brings you here today?
M: I’d like to make my students’ essays into a book.
W: I see. Do you have the essays with you?
M: Yes, I have the file. It’s 100 pages in total, including the cover page.
W: How many copies of the book do you need?
M: I need 200. They’re for my first-year students.
W: Okay. When do you need them?
M: By Wednesday. I’d like to hand them out to my students before the semester ends.
W: Don’t worry. Our new printing machines are really fast. You can pick them up on Tuesday.
M: That’s great. Can I pay on that day?
W: Sure.
script.6:
6. 대화를듣고, 그림에서대화의내용과일치하지않는것을고르시오.
M: Mom, I’m home.
W: Hi, Jason. How was your field trip to Busan?
M: Everything was good. Mom, can I eat something? I’m hungry.
W: Sure. I’ll make you a sandwich. Let’s go to the kitchen.
M: Hmm.... Something looks different here. Did you put a clock on the wall?
W: Yes, I did. I also moved the microwave oven next to the refrigerator.
M: It’ll be convenient when heating cold food from the refrigerator.
W: Sure. Do you see the two cups between the coffee maker and the sink?
M: Yes. They’re the souvenirs from our trip to Taiwan.
W: Right. I knew you’d remember them.
M: Mom, can I eat the bananas in the basket?
W: Sure. Why don’t you sit at the table and eat them?
M: Okay. [Pause] Oh, I like this striped-patterned tablecloth.
W: I’m glad you like it.
script.7:
7. 대화를듣고, 남자가할일로가장적절한것을고르시오.
W: Mr. James, what’s the matter?
M: I’ve received so many complaints from residents recently, Ms. Cameron.
W: What are they complaining about?
M: They say that there are too many advertising flyers illegally posted in our apartment buildings.
W: That’s true. It’s a big problem. People must get permission from the management office to post flyers.
M: Right. They should also put them on the designated bulletin boards.
W: We need to do something. What do you think about putting up a warning notice?
M: Actually, I made a warning notice this morning. Can you take a look at it?
W: Oh, good. [Pause] It looks great.
M: Then, I’ll make copies.
W: Okay. Then, I’ll remove the illegal flyers in the buildings.
M: Sounds good.
script.8:
8. 대화를듣고, 여자의청력이나빠진이유를고르시오.
M: Hello, Ms. Johnson. How are you today?
W: I feel good, Dr. Kim. How are the results of my regular checkup?
M: Let me take a look at your chart. [Pause] It seems that everything’s fine, but your hearing’s gotten worse.
W: Really? Is that serious?
M: No. But it’s strange because it usually happens to older people.
W: But I’m just 28 years old.
M: I know. It may be related to your environment. Do you work at a noisy place?
W: No. I work in a library.
M: I see. Well.... Do you listen to loud music?
W: Yes, I do. I often listen to it with my headphones.
M: That’s the reason. You’d better stop doing that to avoid further damage.
W: Okay, I will. Thanks, Dr. Kim.

9. 대화를듣고, 남자가지불할금액을고르시오. [3점] W: Welcome to Newstream Kayak Club. How may I help you?
M: Hi, I’d like to rent a kayak.
W: Okay. Do you want a single or double one?
M: One single kayak. How much is it?
W: It’s only $20 an hour.
M: That’s great. I’ll rent a single kayak for 3 hours.
W: All right. Do you need a performance paddle?
M: A performance paddle? How’s it different from the regular paddle?
W: It makes paddling easier and faster. It’s $10 an hour.
M: Sounds good. I’ll rent one for 3 hours.
W: Okay. One single kayak and one performance paddle for 3 hours, right?
M: Yes. Also, can I use this coupon? I downloaded it from your website.
W: Sure. You get a 10% discount off the total.
M: Good. I’ll pay by credit card.
W: Okay.
script.10:
10. 대화를듣고, ‘I Care, We Cure’ 행사에관해언급되지않은것을고르시오.
W: Hey, Matt! What’s up?
M: Hi, Jennifer. I just came back from the ‘I Care, We Cure’ event.
W: What’s the event for?
M: It’s for raising public awareness of cancer and its prevention, detection and treatment.
W: That sounds like a meaningful event. What kind of programs do they have?
M: They have photo exhibitions, music concerts and dance performances. Also, you can buy caps and T-shirts.
W: Oh, cool. I’d love to go. Where does it take place?
M: It’s being held in the student union building.
W: Is there an admission fee?
M: No, it’s free. It’ll be great if you buy something though. The profits will be used for cancer research.
W: Okay. I’ll go with my friends later.
M: Good. I hope you like it.

M: Hello, listeners! I’m Samuel Kaplan from the Orange Tree Day Care Center.
Are you a working mom or dad who’s having a hard time finding childcare solutions? The Orange Tree Day Care Center could be your best option. Our center’s located next to Green Oak Park, where children can explore nature.

W: Lucy and Ben are mother and son. It’s Saturday afternoon, and they’re getting ready to drive to the airport to go to San Francisco. Lucy knows that they should leave earlier than usual since there’s always a lot of traffic on Saturdays. But, when they’re about to leave, Ben realizes that his suitcase is too heavy. So he’s now taking time to repack. Lucy is worried that they might miss their flight. Last year on a Saturday afternoon, she missed her flight because she arrived at the airport 30 minutes late due to a traffic jam.
She thinks it could happen again if they don’t hurry. So, she wants to tell Ben that they have to go to the airport right away. In this situation, what would Lucy most likely say to Ben?

script.16:
[16～17] 다음을듣고, 물음에답하시오.
M: Welcome to Taringa Zoo. I’m Derrick Lewis, your tour guide for today. As you know, many mothers devote themselves to raising children. It’s the same in the animal kingdom. However, some animal fathers also commit themselves to parenting. They put enormous effort into helping their young to survive.
One example is the emperor penguin. After the mother penguin lays her egg and leaves to hunt, the father keeps the egg warm, eating nothing. Another dedicated father is the seahorse. The mother seahorse places her eggs in a pouch on the father’s belly, and then the father carries the eggs until they emerge as little seahorses. The giant water bug is also a wonderful example.
The father giant water bug carries eggs on his back until hatching time.
Finally, after the mother sea catfish lays her eggs, the father picks them up in his mouth. The father sea catfish then keeps the eggs there until they hatch. He doesn’t eat during this entire period. Now, let’s go meet these amazing animal fathers in person.
